blind.description: A small, smooth, oval-shaped blank ritual mask resting face-up on the ground. The outer shell is solid, continuous, and convex, colored a pale bone or ivory tone. It features two narrow dark angled eye slits and small dark strap tabs or buckles on either side. No floating, melted, or detached elements.
blind.from_above: An oval, egg-shaped mask or bald face seen from directly above, showing two dark angled eye slits and dark side strap tabs.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4 to 6 inches tall and 8 to 10 inches long, less than one-tenth the height of the 5 ft 9 in scale figure.
